sections.title: Introductory Information
sections.content:
ITEM 7. MD&A

Global eCommerce sales increased 23% in fiscal 2024, surpassing $100 billion. Walmart U.S. comp sales grew 5.6%.

sections.title: Item 8. Financial Statements
sections.content:
ITEM 8. FINANCIAL STATEMENTS


| Revenues (in millions) | 2024 | 2023 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Net sales | $ 642,637 | $ 605,881 |
| Membership and other income | $ 5,488 | $ 5,408 |
| Total revenues | $ 648,125 | $ 611,289 |
| Operating income | $ 27,011 | $ 20,428 |
